tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250mkhyen brtse'i snyan brgyud gnad tig phur pa'i zlog byang*/1$0000300 gdod ma'i bde gshegs snying po las: glo bur rtog pas btags pa yi: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug tshogs: rnam par 'gyur bas byung ba yi: nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zlog: 'bar g.yo 'thibs pa las byung ba'i: gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu zlog: gzung yul zhen pa las byung ba'i: sa chu me rlung g.yo 'khrugs zlog: 'dzin pa'i nga bdag las byung ba'i: rtsa dang rlung gi cho 'phrul zlog: gnyis med ye shes 'khrul pa'i rtsal: kun brtag sems kyi bag chags zlog: sna tshogs rtog pa'i gzhan dbang can: sde brgyad gdug pa'i g.yo 'khrugs zlog: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: mi mthun thams cad dbyings su zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: ye shes chen po mthar phyin mdzod:

༈ rgyun gyi thun gtor 'bul tshig zor ltar bskul ba phyag bzhes su 'byung ba ni/ 'gugs brlabs 'bul ba rnams gzhung ltar byas nas/ hūm̐/ dmar chen gtor zor phur bu'i tshogs// sde brgyad dregs pa'i dpung dang bcas// dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du rbad// srid pa g.yo zhing 'khrugs byed pa'i// dmag dpung der skyod g.yul ngo sprod// dgra dpung choms la bgegs dpung thul// rjes shul lhag ma med par mdzod// dus la bab bo mthu rtsal skyed// oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: dang drag sngags chig dril mthar/ bdud pra mā ra ya rbad nan: kha la dza ma li rbad nan: ra tsa du ling shag rbad nan: shig shig dul dul rbad nan: tshal pa tshal pa rbad nan: khroṃ khroṃ bh+yo rbad nan: rmugs rmugs rbad nan: tir tir rbad nan: tshal tshal rbad nan: zhes drag sngags bzla bzhin du 'phangs pas/ 1$0000250dgra bo'i gzugs phung rdul du bshigs/ rnam shes mar me bsad pa ltar yal/ gnas gzhis longs spyod rjes med du brlags par 1$0000300 bsam mo// ༈ //dil mkhyen rin po che'i ljags sgrig yang phur gtor zlog las 'byung ba'i bskul thung ni/ hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings nas drag po'i skur: gdug pa 'dul phyir khros pa'i lha: bcom ldan dpal chen kī la ya: mi mngon dbyings nas thugs dam bskul: zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po yi: las rnams 'grub par mdzad du gsol: zhes thugs dam bskul lo/// /
